11.46756,43.16721.name: GSK Vaccines S.r.l.
11.46756,43.16721.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of a GSK Company. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-1.23941,52.98122.name: Care Fertility Nottingham
-1.23941,52.98122.state: John Webster House, 6 Lawrence Drive, Nottingham Business Park, Nottingham, NG8 6PZ, United Kingdom
-1.23941,52.98122.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-1.43840,52.42123.state: University Hospitals Coventry & Warwickshire NHS Trust, Clifford Bridge Road, Coventry, CV2 2DX, United Kingdom

-46.64977,-23.61539.name: FERTICLIN - Clinica de Fertilidade Humana
-46.64977,-23.61539.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.ferticlin.com.br. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

-94.58128,39.03795.name: Midwest Research Institute (MRI) - Influenza and Respiratory Pathogen Research Center
-94.58128,39.03795.state: 425 Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd Kansas City, MO 64110, United States
-94.58128,39.03795.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by Midwest Research Institute. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

19.90079,50.02697.name: The Malopolska Centre of Biotechnology Laboratory of Virology
19.90079,50.02697.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by Jagiellonian University. It is categorised as a university laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

120.58530,31.29890.name: Cyagen — Suzhou and Santa Clara facilities
120.58530,31.29890.desc: Production sites for custom engineered mice on two continents, serving clients who commission animals without holding any facility themselves. The resulting lines often appear in no public catalogue, so the animals exist and the strains do not enter the shared record.

-104.99030,39.73920.name: Donor Sibling Registry
-104.99030,39.73920.desc: A voluntary registry through which donor-conceived people and their genetic half-siblings find each other, founded in 2000 by a mother and her donor-conceived son. It has matched tens of thousands of people and repeatedly revealed sibling groups far larger than any clinic disclosed — in some cases well over a hundred. It existed for years before consumer DNA testing made the same discovery unavoidable, and it is still the only place the resulting families are counted.

-77.04300,38.90400.name: NTI | bio — Nuclear Threat Initiative
-77.04300,38.90400.desc: Runs the International Biosecurity and Biosafety Initiative for Science and pushes for mandatory screening of synthetic DNA orders. It is the main organised effort to close the gap this map keeps returning to — that roughly a fifth of world synthesis capacity screens nothing — and it is philanthropy doing what no law requires.

-77.04300,38.90400.name: Danaher — Cytiva and Pall
-77.04300,38.90400.desc: Owns the bioprocessing businesses that supply the bags, filters, resins and single-use systems nearly every biologic is made in. When these ran short during 2020 the constraint on global vaccine supply was not the recipe, it was the plastic. A supplier that can halt production everywhere is part of this industry whatever its own filings say.

-77.04300,38.90400.name: Hollingsworth LLP
-77.04300,38.90400.desc: A firm built around defending manufacturers in mass-tort science cases, including agrochemical and pharmaceutical claims. Its speciality is the admissibility fight — arguing which scientific evidence a jury may hear at all — which decides more cases than the trial does.

-77.04300,38.90400.name: State seed laboratories (United States) — sample submission
-77.04300,38.90400.desc: Most US states run an official seed testing laboratory, and the Association of Official Seed Analysts lists them. Charges are modest and a result from an official laboratory carries weight with a state agriculture department that a private test may not. If a formal complaint is intended, test here first — the enforcement body is more likely to act on a laboratory it already recognises.

3.18000,36.72000.name: Institut National de la Recherche Agronomique d’Algérie
3.18000,36.72000.desc: Algeria imports most of its wheat and has among the highest per-capita cereal consumption in the world, which makes it one of the buyers whose specifications shape what exporting countries plant. Its own research is on adapting cereals to drought.
